affected_predicate.description: A corresponding Coffee Time event is scheduled for the invitation's October 20, 9:10 AM slot.

competing_trace_defects.description: Before reuse, the agent saved Coffee Time on October 16 at 1:00 PM, while the text invitation specifies October 20 at 9:10 AM.

chains.rationale: The reused claim treats the incorrectly scheduled event as complete. From the target onward, the trace opens Messages and sends OK without returning to Calendar or correcting the observed October 16, 1:00 PM event, so the false completion remains uncorrected on the visible path.

summary: The reused false scheduling-completion claim was followed by messaging actions and no visible calendar correction; the independently observable earlier defect is the event saved at the wrong date and time.
